_comment: THE PM v2 grade-target cases (r1 P1-1), ONE file iterated by tests/pm-report-v2-shared.test.ts (the pure twin `gradeTargetProblem`) AND scripts/sql-harness-0271.mjs (the RPC `save_pm_copy_grade`), so the lib and the database cannot drift. Symbols: position = own_active | own_retired | other_shop | nonexistent | null (no position); worked = the subject has a station event at that position on the report's day at the copy's shop; added = this | other | null (a live pm_copy_positions row in THIS copy, or in ANOTHER manager's copy of the same day); criterion = own_shared | own_position_same | own_position_other | own_inactive | other_shop. expect: null = accepted, else the refusal code. fkBackstop: a direct INSERT of that (position or criterion, shop) pair fails the composite FK.

cases.name: (a) a position of the OTHER shop
(b) a RETIRED position of this shop
(c) a UUID that is no position at all
(d) a valid shop position the subject never held that day
(e1) the same position, added by THIS copy
(e2) the same position, added by ANOTHER manager's copy
(f) a criterion of the other shop
(g) a position criterion with a different position
(h) a shared criterion with no position
a worked position with its own criterion
a worked position with a shared criterion
a position criterion with no position
a retired position never held: retired is named first
another shop's position with its criterion: the shop is named first
